construction: 41 parts in 13 steps. Steps 1–7: plates, a 1×4 brick with side studs and Technic bricks form the body. Step 8: four 1×1 headlight bricks give sideways studs. Step 11: a 4×4 round plate ringed by four 2×2 corner-round tiles makes the disc. Step 12: a 2×2 dish. Step 13: a shift linkage of a locking hinge arm and a 45° angle connector.
interfaces: The parent rotates it 90° about Y. The headlight bricks carry the disc on their side studs.
lesson: A sideways round disc on headlight-brick studs. The parent shows it is a drive cover, not the headlight nacelle the database names.
parent_context: The left primary-drive (belt) cover beside the footboard of the motorcycle (`10269 - main.ldr`).
reuse_notes: Use the headlight-brick ring for any sideways round cover: a hub face, a dial or a porthole. Keep the corner-round tiles with the 4×4 round plate.
